nodes.title: Hand 1 — Hero folds preflop SB vs BB
nodes.body:
Hero pos: SB/button. Hero hole: 8c Qc. Board: none (preflop fold).
Actions: hero post SB 1, villain post BB 2, hero fold.
Showdown: no. Villain revealed: 4d 3c (weak offsuit connector).
Result: hero -1.
Notes: Villain held 4d3c in BB — no voluntary action taken, so no aggression or sizing reads. Hand only establishes villain can be dealt weak holdings.

nodes.title: Hand 10 — Villain SB calls preflop, folds to flop c-bet on Q-high board
nodes.body: Hero BB with AdTc. Villain SB called preflop (limp). Hero checked preflop option. Flop: Qh 7c 5d. Hero bet 3, villain folded immediately. Hero +2. Another SB limp/call → fold to flop c-bet. Consistent with Hand 8 pattern.

nodes.title: Hand 11 — Villain BB calls hero SB raise, folds to flop c-bet on 9h Td Kc
nodes.body: Hero SB with QdJd raised to 8. Villain BB called. Flop 9h Td Kc — villain checked, hero bet 10, villain folded. Hero +8. Notable: villain called preflop raise from BB (not a limp), but still folded to flop c-bet. Board was connected/high and villain gave up.

nodes.title: Hand 12 — Villain SB raises with JhTd; hero folds BB (TsAs)
nodes.body: Hero in BB with TsAs. Villain (SB) raised to 8. Hero folded. Villain revealed JhTd. Hero result: -2. Notable: villain raised SB with a speculative connector (JhTd), not just a premium hand. This widens the observed SB raising range beyond AdJd.

nodes.title: Hand 13 — Hero folds preflop SB (TdQc); villain holds 4d9s in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded preflop with TdQc. Villain BB held 4d9s — another weak/offsuit BB holding. Villain wins blinds uncontested.

nodes.title: Hand 14 — Villain SB folds preflop; hero BB wins uncontested
nodes.body: Hero: BB with Ks3d. Villain folded preflop from SB. Hero wins +1.

nodes.title: Hand 15 — Hero folds preflop SB (5s9h); villain holds Td6c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded preflop with 5s9h. Villain BB held Td6c — another weak offsuit holding in BB.

nodes.title: Hand 16 — Villain SB calls preflop, checks flop, folds to turn bet on 6d Ks 4h 5d
nodes.body: Hero BB (3s 6h) vs villain SB. Villain calls preflop. Hero checks flop (6d Ks 4h). Villain checks back (postflop passivity). Hero bets 3 on turn (5d). Villain folds. Hero wins +2. Villain folded to a turn bet after checking flop — extends fold-to-postflop-bet pattern beyond flop c-bets.

nodes.title: Hand 17 — Hero folds preflop SB (5h4h); villain holds 6h5c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded 5h4h preflop. Villain BB held 6h5c — another weak offsuit connector. Villain wins blinds uncontested.

nodes.title: Hand 18 — Villain SB raises with A6o; hero folds BB (3s6c)
nodes.body: Hero BB (3s6c), villain SB raised to 8. Hero folded. Villain revealed 6d Ac (A6o). Confirms villain raises SB with Ax hands, even offsuit medium kickers. Range getting wider: AdJd, JhTd, and now A6o all raise from SB.

nodes.title: Hand 19 — Hero folds TT preflop SB; villain holds 55 in BB
nodes.body: Hero (SB): Td Th — folded preflop. Villain (BB): 5h 5d. Hero folded a dominant hand (TT vs 55 = ~82% favorite). Significant error — reinforces need to stop over-folding SB vs villain's weak BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 2 — Villain calls preflop, checks down with Q-high
nodes.body:
Hero: BB with 6d4c. Villain: SB with 6hQc.
Board: 4h Th Ad 3h 7s
Preflop: Villain calls, hero checks.
Flop/Turn/River: Both check through.
Showdown: Hero wins with pair of 4s vs villain Q-high.
Villain had top-card bluff opportunity on A-high board but checked down entire street.

nodes.title: Hand 20 — Villain SB folds preflop; hero BB wins uncontested
nodes.body: Hero: BB with 7s6h. Villain SB folded preflop. Hero wins blinds (+1).

nodes.title: Hand 21 — Hero folds Ad4s preflop SB; villain holds 7dKh in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded Ad4s preflop vs villain BB. Villain held 7dKh — a weak offsuit hand. Another major hero over-fold: A4o is well ahead of villain's BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 22 — Villain SB limps, checks flop+turn, folds to hero river bet
nodes.body: Hero BB (2h5c) vs villain SB limp. Board: 4h As 7h 4d 6h. Villain called preflop, checked flop and turn, then folded to hero's small river bet of 3. Hero scoops +2. Another postflop fold — now 5/5 folds to any hero postflop bet.

nodes.title: Hand 23 — Hero folds K5o preflop SB; villain holds Jc3h in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded K5o preflop. Villain held Jc3h — another case where hero folded a dominant hand vs villain's trash BB holding.

nodes.title: Hand 24 — Villain SB calls preflop, folds to flop c-bet on 2d Ad Ts
nodes.body:
Hero BB holds 7d Ks. Villain SB calls preflop (limp). Hero checks preflop.
Flop: 2d Ad Ts — hero bets 3, villain folds.
Hero wins +2. Another routine fold to any flop bet.

nodes.title: Hand 25 — Hero folds preflop SB (5h4c); villain holds Qd7d in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded 5h4c from SB. Villain held Qd7d in BB and won uncontested. Another hero over-fold — 54o is marginal but villain's BB range is very wide (e.g., Jc3h, Td6c, 6h5c seen previously).

nodes.title: Hand 26 — Villain SB calls preflop, checks flop, folds to hero turn bet on 6c 3c Qs 9s
nodes.body: Hero BB: 5s Ad. Villain SB called preflop. Flop 6c 3c Qs — both check. Turn 9s — hero bets 3, villain folds. Hero wins +2. Another fold to postflop bet.

nodes.title: Hand 27 — Hero folds preflop SB (3h5c); villain holds 2d6h in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folds 3h5c preflop. Villain BB holds 2d6h — another trash hand. Hero over-folding continues.

nodes.title: Hand 28 — Villain SB calls, calls flop c-bet, folds to turn bet on Ts 4c 7d 7h
nodes.body: Hero BB with 9c Jh. Villain SB calls preflop. Hero checks BB preflop. Board: Ts 4c 7d | 7h. Hero bets flop 3 → villain CALLS (first flop c-bet call). Hero bets turn 7 → villain folds. Hero wins +5. Notable: villain called flop but gave up on turn when board paired 7s and bet size increased.

nodes.title: Hand 29 — Hero folds preflop SB (8s9c); villain holds AcAs in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded 8s9c preflop. Villain BB held AcAs — pocket aces. Revealed at showdown (no showdown reached). Hero fold was actually correct here given villain's hand, but hero didn't know that.

nodes.title: Hand 3 — Hero folds preflop SB vs BB; villain holds Ts2s
nodes.body:
Hero pos: SB/button. Hero hole: Ac3d. Villain hole: Ts2s (revealed at showdown).
Preflop: Hero posts SB 1, villain posts BB 2, hero folds. Villain wins uncontested.
No postflop action. Hero result: -1.
Note: Villain's BB holding (Ts2s) is a weak suited hand — expected range for BB, no information on voluntary aggression.

nodes.title: Hand 30 — Villain SB limps Td8h, bets flop+turn; hero BB folds middle pair on turn
nodes.body:
Hero BB: 8d2d. Villain SB limped. Board: 9c 8s 5s 7c.
Flop: Hero checks, villain bets 3 — hero calls (middle pair 8s).
Turn 7c: Hero checks, villain bets 7 — hero folds.
Villain showed Td8h: middle pair + open-ended straight draw on flop (6 or J to complete), maintained aggression on turn.
KEY: First observed instance of villain initiating postflop bets with a real hand. Villain is NOT always passive postflop — will bet for value/semi-bluff with made hands + draws.
Hero result: -5.

nodes.title: Hand 31 — Hero folds K5o preflop SB; villain holds 6dJd in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded K5o from SB. Villain held 6dJd in BB — another marginal hand winning uncontested. Hero continues to over-fold SB.

nodes.title: Hand 32 — Villain SB folds preflop; hero BB wins uncontested
nodes.body: Hero: BB with 4cQh. Villain SB folded preflop. Hero wins +1.

nodes.title: Hand 33 — Hero folds A3o preflop SB; villain holds 6hQc in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded 3d Ah from SB preflop. Villain held 6hQc in BB. Another significant hero over-fold — A3o is a profitable open vs villain's wide BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 34 — Villain SB limps Js5s, bets flop on 7d 4s 5c (middle pair), hero BB folds K9o
nodes.body:
Hero BB: Kd9h. Villain SB: Js5s.
Preflop: villain limped, hero checked.
Flop: 7d 4s 5c. Hero checked, villain bet 3, hero folded.
Showdown: villain showed Js5s (middle pair of 5s).
Notable: Villain bet flop with just middle pair — no draw, no flush draw. Second instance of villain leading postflop with a made hand. Reinforces that villain's bets are value-oriented.

nodes.title: Hand 35 — Hero folds KAo preflop SB (!!); villain holds 2s8d in BB
nodes.body: Hero posted SB, folded preflop with KcAs — an enormous mistake. Villain held 2s8d in BB (trash). Hero gave up a premium hand vs a junk BB hand. Continues a pattern of severe SB over-folding.

nodes.title: Hand 36 — Villain SB raises with KsTo; hero folds BB (8dJd)
nodes.body: Villain raised to 8 from SB with TsKd. Hero folded BB holding 8dJd. Villain wins blinds uncontested. Adds KTo to confirmed SB raise range.

nodes.title: Hand 37 — Hero folds Ad6c preflop SB; villain holds 8cTc in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded Ad6c preflop. Villain BB held 8cTc. Another clear over-fold by hero — A6o is a standard SB open.

nodes.title: Hand 38 — Villain SB limps 6h5s, checks down entire KhKsAs4cKc board
nodes.body:
Villain SB limped 6h5s. Hero BB checked preflop with 5h2s.
Board: KhKsAs4cKc — extremely dry, three kings on board.
Both players checked flop, turn, and river.
Showdown: Villain 6h5s (trip kings, 6-kicker) beats hero 5h2s (trip kings, 5-kicker). Hero -2.
Key observation: Villain checked down with a weak holding on a passive board — consistent with postflop passivity. 6h5s is another speculative/connective SB limp hand.

nodes.title: Hand 39 — Hero folds 6c8c preflop SB; villain holds 5c6h in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded 6c8c in SB preflop. Villain held 5c6h — a dominated hand. Hero had the better hand and folded. Another over-fold.

nodes.title: Hand 4 — Villain calls preflop SB, folds to hero 3-bet from BB
nodes.body:
Hero pos: BB, hero hole: TcAh
Villain in SB: called 1bb preflop. Hero raised to 8bb. Villain folded.
No board. Hero wins +2. Villain hole cards not revealed.

nodes.title: Hand 40 — Villain SB calls preflop, checks flop, folds to hero turn bet on 9c 7h 3c 4s
nodes.body: Hero BB: 4h7s. Villain SB called preflop. Flop 9c7h3c: hero checked, villain checked. Turn 4s: hero bet 3, villain folded. Hero +2. Another fold to postflop bet — villain checked flop (weakness signal) and folded to turn bet. Reinforces: when villain checks, fire.

nodes.title: Hand 41 — Hero folds JJ preflop SB (!!); villain holds 6hTs in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded Js Jd preflop. Villain BB held 6h Ts. Catastrophic over-fold — JJ is a premium hand.

nodes.title: Hand 42 — Villain SB limps Kh8d, raises hero's flop bet on Td Jh 9s (double gutshot semi-bluff)
nodes.body:
Villain SB limps Kh8d. Hero BB checks preflop with 6cKc.
Flop: Td Jh 9s. Hero bets 3. Villain raises to 15. Hero folds.
Showdown: villain had Kh8d — double gutshot draw (Q for KQJT9 or 7 for 789TJ) = ~8 outs.
Key insight: Villain WILL raise postflop as a semi-bluff on connected boards with strong draws. Previously believed villain only bets/raises with made hands — this complicates the read. Villain raised to 5x hero's bet with only a draw.

nodes.title: Hand 43 — Hero folds T2o preflop SB; villain holds 8h8d in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded 2cTc from SB. Villain held 8h8d. Another hero preflop fold — T2o is borderline but villain's BB range is wide enough that this could be raised or at least limp-called.

nodes.title: Hand 44 — Villain SB calls 6cQc, bets flop Jd9h7s with OESD semi-bluff; hero BB folds middle pair
nodes.body:
Hero BB: 9d6h. Villain SB: 6cQc (called preflop).
Flop: Jd 9h 7s. Hero checks (middle pair), villain bets 3, hero folds.
Villain showed 6cQc — 6c has OESD (5 or 8 = 8 outs), Qc adds gutshot (T), backdoor flush.
Another strong-draw semi-bluff on a connected board. Hero had middle pair and folded, consistent with over-folding pattern.
Note: Hero SHOULD have called/raised with middle pair here — villain is semi-bluffing with a draw, hero had ~70% equity vs 6cQc on Jd9h7s.

nodes.title: Hand 45 — Hero folds J4o preflop SB; villain holds 6sQs in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded Js4c preflop. Villain BB held 6sQs. Reasonable fold by hero. Villain BB range continues to be very wide/weak.

nodes.title: Hand 46 — Villain SB calls 9dJs, bets flop on 8d Ks 6c (OESD semi-bluff); hero BB folds 2s7c
nodes.body:
Hero BB: 2s7c. Villain SB: 9dJs. Preflop: villain calls, hero checks.
Flop 8d Ks 6c: hero checks, villain bets 3. Hero folds.
Villain had 9dJs — OESD (T or 7 makes straight on 8-6 board) + backdoor diamond draw.
Another semi-bluff bet on a connected board with strong draw equity (~8 outs).
Result: hero -2.

nodes.title: Hand 47 — Hero folds A9o preflop SB (!!); villain holds 8hQd in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds 9c Ac from SB preflop. Villain holds 8h Qd in BB. Another critical over-fold — A9o is a strong hand that dominates villain's wide BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 48 — Villain SB limps Qd6d, bets flop on JhTcAh (OESD semi-bluff); hero BB folds K-high
nodes.body:
Hero BB: 2s Kc. Villain SB limps.
Flop: Jh Tc Ah. Hero checks, villain bets 3, hero folds.
Villain held Qd6d — OESD (K or 9 completes straight: AKQJT or QJT98). Another semi-bluff on a connected board.
Hero K-high no pair — fold was fine, but illustrates villain's draw-betting pattern again.

nodes.title: Hand 49 — Hero folds 3c4c preflop SB; villain holds 2dJh in BB
nodes.body: Hand 49: Hero folds 3c4c preflop SB. Villain holds 2dJh in BB (another weak BB hand). Hero result: -1.

nodes.title: Hand 5 — Hero folds preflop SB vs BB (KdAd!); villain holds 5d7s
nodes.body: Hero pos: SB. Hero hole: KdAd. Hero folded preflop (error). Villain BB with 5d7s — wins blinds uncontested. Villain's third revealed hand: another weak holding (5-high, suited connector low end).

nodes.title: Hand 50 — Villain SB limps Qs5h, bets flop on 8s Js Kh (flush draw semi-bluff); hero BB folds Ah4d
nodes.body:
Hero BB: Ah 4d. Villain SB limps.
Flop: 8s Js Kh.
Hero checks. Villain bets 3. Hero folds.
Villain shows: Qs 5h — queen-high flush draw (9 outs).

Key observations:
- Villain SB limped Qs5h — very wide limp range confirmed again.
- Villain bet the flop with a flush draw (not OESD) — expands semi-bluff draw type beyond straight draws.
- Hero folded A-high (Ah4d) with no pair on K-high board; reasonable fold, but note Ah blocks some of villain's nut flush draw equity.
- Pattern: villain bets draws on flop regardless of draw type (straight OR flush).

nodes.title: Hand 51 — Hero folds 72o preflop SB; villain holds 3d4c in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds 7h2s preflop SB (correct fold). Villain holds 3d4c in BB — another very weak holding in BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 52 — Villain SB calls 9s4c, flops straight (7-8-9-T), bets flop, raises turn, bets river; hero BB folds pair+flush draw
nodes.body:
Hero BB: 6c Qc. Villain SB: 9s4c.
Board: Tc 8h 7c 6s Ks
Preflop: Villain calls (SB limp). Hero checks BB.
Flop (Tc 8h 7c): Hero checks. Villain bets 3 — has FLOPPED STRAIGHT (7-8-9-T). Hero calls with flush draw + backdoors.
Turn (6s): Hero bets 7. Villain RAISES to 25 — still nut straight. Hero calls 18 (pair of 6s + flush draw).
River (Ks): Hero checks. Villain bets 45. Hero folds.
Result: Hero -30. Villain wins with 7-high straight.

Key notes:
- Villain called preflop with 9s4c (very weak, confirms ultra-wide SB call range)
- Villain flopped the straight and bet small (3 into pot) — could look like a draw bet
- Villain raised hero's turn bet with made hand — consistent with 'bets/raises made hands AND draws'
- Hero correctly called turn (had pair+flush draw) but villain held the nuts
- Villain bet river for value with made hand — no slowplay

nodes.title: Hand 53 — Hero folds 33 preflop SB; villain holds 9dTs in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds 3c3h from SB preflop. Villain holds 9dTs in BB. Another hero over-fold — 33 is a clear open/raise from SB heads-up.

nodes.title: Hand 54 — Villain SB limps 9cTh, bets dry KdKc5h board as pure bluff; hero BB folds T-high
nodes.body:
Hand 54: Hero BB holds 7cTd. Villain SB limps. Hero checks preflop.
Flop: Kd Kc 5h (dry, paired board).
Hero checks. Villain bets 3. Hero folds.
Villain shows: 9cTh — T-high, no pair, no real draw. Pure air bluff on a dry board.

SIGNIFICANCE: First observed instance of villain betting postflop with NO made hand and NO strong draw (~8+ outs). Board was completely dry — no straight draws, no flush draw. Villain bluffed with T-high into a paired K-K-5 board. This updates/contradicts the prior model that villain only bets with equity.

nodes.title: Hand 55 — Hero folds A3o preflop SB; villain holds Kd9c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folds Ah3c preflop. Villain BB holds Kd9c. Another critical over-fold — A3o dominates villain's wide BB range.

nodes.title: Hand 56 — Villain SB limps Tc8d, bets flop on Jd5d6c (gutshot + backdoor flush semi-bluff); hero BB folds bottom pair
nodes.body:
Hand 56: Hero BB holds 6d3h (bottom pair on 6c). Villain SB limped Tc8d preflop. Flop Jd 5d 6c. Hero checks, villain bets 3. Hero folds.

Villain's Tc8d on Jd5d6c:
- Gutshot to 9 (completes J-T-9-8 straight)
- Backdoor flush draw (Td + Jd5d board diamonds)
WET connected board — fits semi-bluff with equity pattern.

Hero folded bottom pair (6d3h) — reasonable given villain's draw-heavy betting on wet boards.

nodes.title: Hand 57 — Hero folds preflop SB (7h2h); villain holds 7c8c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded 7h2h preflop. Villain BB held 7c8c. Reasonable fold with 72o.

nodes.title: Hand 58 — Villain SB limps 3s4d, bets flop on 9s 7s Ah (flush draw semi-bluff); hero BB folds Tc2s
nodes.body:
Hero BB: Tc2s. Villain SB: 3s4d.
Preflop: villain limps, hero checks BB.
Flop 9s 7s Ah: hero checks, villain bets 3, hero folds.
Villain revealed 3s4d — flush draw (3s on two-spade board = 9 outs). Wet board semi-bluff. Hero fold was correct (T2o has no equity).
Another data point: villain bets wet boards with draws regardless of overall hand strength.

nodes.title: Hand 59 — Hero folds 4h9h preflop SB; villain holds 8h9c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded 4h9h preflop. Villain held 8h9c in BB. Hero over-folding continues.

nodes.title: Hand 6 — Villain raises preflop SB with AdJd; hero folds BB (K7o)
nodes.body: Hero BB (7sKh), villain SB. Villain raised to 8 (4x). Hero folded K7o. Villain revealed AdJd at showdown (no showdown, but cards shown). Strong holding — villain chose to raise rather than limp/call with AJd.

nodes.title: Hand 60 — Villain SB limps 5s9d, bets flop on 3s Qh Kh (pure bluff with air); hero BB folds bottom pair
nodes.body:
Villain SB limped 5s9d. Hero BB held 3c5c (bottom pair on flop).
Flop: 3s Qh Kh. Hero checked. Villain bet 3. Hero folded.
Revealed: villain had 5s9d — no pair, no flush draw, no straight draw. Pure bluff on semi-wet K-high board.
Hero folded bottom pair (pair of 3s) which was ahead of villain's air.
Confirms villain bluffs beyond just dry/paired boards — will bet any board with nothing.

nodes.title: Hand 61 — Hero folds A7o preflop SB (!!); villain holds QsQc in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded As7c preflop. Villain held QsQc in BB. Another massive over-fold — A7o is a clear open from SB at any reasonable strategy. Villain had a premium hand here but hero never found out.

nodes.title: Hand 62 — Villain SB raises Kc9c; hero BB folds QhTc
nodes.body: Villain raised SB to 8 with Kc9c (suited K9). Hero folded QhTc from BB (-2). Another wide SB raise — K9s is not a premium. Hero's fold of QTo is marginal but villain raises wide enough that defending is reasonable.

nodes.title: Hand 63 — Hero folds J7o preflop SB; villain holds 3h7s in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded Jh7c from SB. Villain held 3h7s in BB. Another hero over-fold — J7o is marginal but villain's BB range includes 3h7s and far worse.

nodes.title: Hand 64 — Villain SB limps 9h7h, bets flop on 6s 3h 2s (pure bluff/gutshot); hero BB folds bottom pair+top kicker (Ac6c)
nodes.body:
Hero BB: Ac6c. Villain SB limped.
Flop: 6s 3h 2s. Hero checked, villain bet 3. Hero folded.
Villain showed 9h7h — essentially air (no pair, gutshot needing 5 and 4 for a straight = backdoor at best).
Hero had pair of 6s + Ace kicker + backdoor nut flush draw — a CLEAR call vs villain's bluff-heavy range.
Another instance of hero folding pair to villain's small flop bet = costly error.
This is villain's 3rd documented pure bluff on flop (joining H54, H60).

nodes.title: Hand 65 — Hero folds 3h4d preflop SB; villain holds 9dJc in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded 3h4d from SB preflop. Villain held 9dJc in BB. Reasonable fold with 34o.

nodes.title: Hand 66 — Villain SB limps 7c8h, bets flop Th Qc Kc as pure bluff; hero BB folds 8c7d (air)
nodes.body: Hero BB: 8c7d. Villain SB limps. Hero checks preflop. Flop Th Qc Kc. Hero checks, villain bets 3, hero folds. Villain shows 7c8h — pure bluff with total air on T-Q-K board. Hero fold was reasonable (no pair, no draw of significance). 4th pure bluff by villain observed.

nodes.title: Hand 67 — Hero folds preflop SB (5d2c); villain holds 4c6s in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds 5d2c from SB — reasonable fold with near-bottom of range. Villain holds 4c6s in BB (trash hand, consistent with extremely wide BB range).

nodes.title: Hand 68 — Villain SB limps 4d7h, bets flop on Qs Kh Jd (pure bluff/air); hero BB folds 3s8c (air)
nodes.body:
Villain SB limps 4d7h. Hero BB checks. Flop Qs Kh Jd. Hero checks, villain bets 3, hero folds 3s8c.
Revealed: villain held 4d7h — complete air, no pair, no draw (gutshot at best — 9 or T would make straight but villain has no straight draw; 4 and 7 miss this board entirely).
Hero fold correct — 3s8c also has nothing.
Category: PURE BLUFF (5th observed). Villain bluffs any board texture including Broadway-heavy boards.

nodes.title: Hand 69 — Hero folds T6o preflop SB; villain holds Jh6h in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds Ts6d preflop SB. Villain holds Jh6h in BB. Another hero over-fold from SB.

nodes.title: Hand 7 — Hero folds preflop SB vs BB; villain holds 4sAc
nodes.body: Hero (SB) folded preflop with 9s7d. Villain (BB) held 4sAc — wins blinds uncontested. Another BB hand revealed: Ac4s, a mixed strength hand (suited ace but weak kicker).

nodes.title: Hand 70 — Villain SB raises AsQh; hero BB folds 6c3d
nodes.body: Villain raises SB with AsQh (premium). Hero folds 6c3d — reasonable fold with trash.

nodes.title: Hand 71 — Hero folds QTo preflop SB; villain holds Ac7d in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds Qh Tc preflop SB. Villain holds Ac7d in BB. Another critical hero over-fold — QTo is a clear open from SB.

nodes.title: Hand 72 — Villain SB raises KsTs; hero BB folds AJo (!)
nodes.body: Villain SB raises to 8 with KsTs. Hero BB folds AdJh — a massive over-fold vs a wide SB raise range. AJo dominates much of villain's raising range and should be an easy 3-bet or call.

nodes.title: Hand 73 — Hero folds T8o preflop SB; villain holds 9s6c in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folds 8hTc preflop. Villain BB holds 9s6c. Another hero over-fold — T8o is playable and beats villain's 96o.

nodes.title: Hand 74 — Villain SB folds preflop; hero BB wins uncontested
nodes.body: Hero BB: 6h3s. Villain SB folds preflop. Hero wins +1.

nodes.title: Hand 75 — Hero folds AsJd preflop SB (!!); villain holds 6h3d in BB
nodes.body: Hero folds AsJd (AJo!) preflop from SB. Villain holds 6h3d — complete trash. Another catastrophic over-fold by hero with a premium hand.

nodes.title: Hand 76 — Villain SB limps 5cJc, bets flop on 6s7d8s (gutshot semi-bluff/weak draw); hero BB folds QsJh (overcards)
nodes.body:
Hero BB: QsJh. Villain SB limps 5cJc.
Flop: 6s 7d 8s. Hero checks, villain bets 3, hero folds.
Villain reveals 5cJc — has gutshot to 9 (5-6-7-8-9), otherwise near-air.
Hero had two overcards (Q-J), no straight draw on this board. Folding is defensible vs unknown range but given villain's 80%+ bluff rate, hero should call with any two overcards.
Category: weak draw / near-bluff (4 outs gutshot only).

nodes.title: Hand 77 — Hero folds AKo preflop SB (!!!); villain holds 9sJh in BB
nodes.body: Hero in SB with AsKh — folded preflop. Villain held 9sJh. AKo is the best possible non-pair hand. This is an extreme over-fold. Hero lost 1 chip (SB post).

nodes.title: Hand 78 — Villain SB limps Kh8c, bets flop on 7s 4s 6h (gutshot semi-bluff); hero BB folds K8o
nodes.body:
Villain SB limped Kh8c. Hero BB checked preflop. Flop: 7s 4s 6h. Hero checked, villain bet 3. Hero folded Kc8s.
Villain held Kh8c — K-high + gutshot (5 completes 4-5-6-7-8). Weak draw semi-bluff. Hero had same exact hand ranks (K8) and folded — should have called given villain's bluff rate.
Hero net: -2.

nodes.title: Hand 79 — Hero folds K5o preflop SB; villain holds 3s2s in BB
nodes.body: Hero folded Kc5d from SB vs BB. Villain held 3s2s — hero folded better hand. Another SB over-fold.

nodes.title: Hand 8 — Villain SB calls preflop, folds to flop c-bet on A-high board
nodes.body: Hero: BB with As 8c. Villain: SB calls preflop (limp). Board: Qd 5s Ad. Hero bets 3 on flop; villain folds immediately. No showdown — villain's hand unknown but likely weak given fold to single flop bet on an ace-high board. Consistent with SB limp = weak range pattern.

nodes.title: Hand 80 — Villain SB limps 3d4d, bets flop on 9d Tc 6c (gutshot semi-bluff); hero BB folds middle pair (9h8d)
nodes.body: Villain limped 3d4d SB. Flop 9d Tc 6c — villain has gutshot (any 5 or 7 makes straight) + backdoor flush. Hero had middle pair (99) with 9h8d and folded to villain's flop bet. Another hero mistake — should call with middle pair given villain's 82% bluff rate on flop bets.

nodes.title: Hand 9 — Hero folds preflop SB (QJo); villain holds Ks5d in BB
nodes.body: Hero SB folded QdJc preflop. Villain BB held Ks5d — wins blinds uncontested. Another data point: villain's BB holding is a weak Kx hand.

nodes.title: villain
nodes.body:
Hands played: 80
Hand 80: Villain SB limped 3d4d, bet flop 9d Tc 6c (gutshot+backdoor flush semi-bluff); hero BB folded middle pair (9h8d) — another hero error.

Key tendencies:
- SB raise range WIDE: AdJd, JhTd, A6o, KsTo, Kc9c, AsQh, KsTs (7 observed) — suited broadways, offsuit broadways, A-x. Very wide.
- SB limp range: extremely wide, near-trash included. ANY two cards.
- SB call range: includes weak suited connectors/one-gappers.
- SB fold preflop: 4 times (H14, H20, H32, H74).
- Folds to flop c-bet: 4/5 (80%).
- Folds to ANY postflop hero bet eventually: 9/9 (100%) when villain checks first.
- Villain postflop aggression: 18 total bets/raises. 3x made hand (17%), 7x strong draw semi-bluff (39%), 8x weak draw/pure bluff (44%).
- BLUFF RATE: Villain is bluffing or semi-bluffing 83% of the time when he bets flop. Hero should CALL any pair vs villain's flop bets.
- NO SIZING TELL: Villain uses same small bet sizing for draws AND made hands AND bluffs.
- When villain CHECKS any street, he is weak — fire freely.
- When villain LEADS: hero should call with any pair or any draw — villain only has value 17% of the time.
- BB range is extremely wide: includes any two cards (4c6s, 2d6h, Ts2s, Jh6h, Ac7d, 9s6c, 6h3d, 3s2s, etc.).
- CRITICAL EXPLOITATION: Hero massively over-folding SB — folded AKo (H77!!!), AJo (H75!!), JJ (H41), KAo (H35), TT (H19), A9o (H47), A7o (H61), QTo (H71), T8o (H73), K5o (H79) and many others. Hero MUST open any playable hand from SB.
- CRITICAL EXPLOITATION 2: Hero must call villain's flop bets with any pair or decent draw. Villain is bluffing or semi-bluffing 15/18 times (83%).
- CRITICAL EXPLOITATION 3: Hero folds BB too wide vs villain SB raises — villain raises K9s, KTo, A6o, JTo, AJo, AQo, KTs. Hero should defend AJo+, QTo+, any pair, all broadways — even 3-bet bluff wide.

nodes.title: Villain Folds to Preflop 3-Bet
nodes.body:
Villain called preflop then folded when hero re-raised (3-bet) from BB.
Fold to 3-bet: 1/1 (Hand 4 — SB call, folded to BB raise to 8x)
Small sample but consistent with calling wide and not defending vs aggression.

Folds to flop c-bet: 4/5 (80%).
Hand 8: SB called preflop, folded to 3-chip bet on Qd 5s Ad.

nodes.title: Villain Folds to Any Postflop Bet (Flop or Turn or River)
nodes.body: Folds to postflop hero bet: 9/9 (100%). Hands: 8(flop), 10(flop), 11(flop), 16(turn), 22(river), 24(flop), 26(turn), 28(turn), 40(turn). Hand 28 villain called flop but still folded on turn — ultimate fold happens within the hand every time. Any street bet works, may need to barrel twice if villain calls flop.

nodes.title: Villain Postflop Passivity — Checks Down or Folds Weak Hands (but DOES bet real hands)
nodes.body:
Hand 2: Checked Q-high down entire board — pure passivity.
Hand 8: Folded to flop c-bet on Qd 5s Ad.
Hand 10: Folded to flop c-bet on Qh 7c 5d.
Hand 11: Folded to flop c-bet on 9h Td Kc.
Hand 16: Checked flop, folded to turn bet — passive check/surrender.
Hand 22: Limped, checked flop+turn, folded to river bet.
Hand 24: Limped, folded to flop c-bet.
Hand 26: Called preflop, checked flop, folded to turn bet.
Hand 28: Called flop c-bet, then folded to turn bet — floated once, gave up.
HAND 30 EXCEPTION: Villain limped Td8h, then BET flop and BET turn on 9c 8s 5s 7c — middle pair + OESD. Villain DOES bet with real equity.
HAND 34 EXCEPTION: Villain limped Js5s, BET flop on 7d 4s 5c (middle pair). Second documented postflop aggression with real equity.
Hand 38: Limped 6h5s, checked down entire KhKsAs4cKc board — passive with weak holding, let it go to showdown.
Passivity count: Passive/check-down in 10/12 postflop opportunities. Villain leads postflop only with genuine equity (2/12).
RULE: If villain checks any street, he is almost certainly weak — bet relentlessly. If villain leads, give respect — he likely has a made hand or strong draw.

meta.note: H30: Td8h middle pair+OESD led. H34: Js5s middle pair led.

nodes.title: Villain Preflop Calling Range (SB)
nodes.body:
SB limp/call hands observed: 6hQo (H2), Td8h (H30), Js5s (H34), 6h5s (H38), Kh8d (H42), Qd6d (H48), Qs5h (H50), 9s4c (H52). Other limps in H8,10,16,22,24,26,28,40,44,46 unknown.
BB holdings observed (uncontested): Ts2s, 5d7s, 4sAc, Ks5d, 4d9s, Td6c, 6h5c, 5h5d, 7dKh, Jc3h, Qd7d, 2d6h, AcAs, 6dJd, 6hQc, 2s8d, 8cTc, 5c6h, 6hTs, 8h8d, 6sQs, 8hQd, 2dJh, 3d4c.
SB limp range is very wide — connectors, one-gappers, suited/offsuit medium holdings, K8o, Q6o, Q5s, 9-4o. ANY two cards essentially.
SB raise = stronger holdings (AJo, JTo, A6o, KTo documented).
SB limp = medium/weak speculative hands — no apparent minimum hand quality. 9-4o confirms villain will limp with near-trash.

nodes.title: Villain Preflop Raising Range (SB)
nodes.body: Observed raises: AdJd (H6), JhTd (H12), A6o (H18), KsTo (H36), Kc9c (H62), AsQh (H70), KsTs (H72). 7 raises total. Range includes premiums (AQ, AJ) plus speculative broadway and suited hands (KTo, KTs, K9s, JTo, A6o). Very wide — hero should defend BB with AJo+, QTo+, any pair, suited broadways, and consider 3-betting wide.

nodes.title: Villain Postflop Betting — Bets/Raises with Made Hands, Strong Draws, AND Bluffs
nodes.body:
Hand 30: Villain SB limped Td8h. Villain led flop+turn with middle pair + OESD. Hero folded.
Hand 34: Villain SB limped Js5s. Villain led flop with middle pair. Hero folded K9o.
Hand 42: Villain SB limped Kh8d. Hero bet 3, villain RAISED to 15 with double gutshot (~8 outs). Hero folded.
Hand 44: Villain SB called 6cQc. Board Jd 9h 7s. Villain bet 3 with OESD + backdoor flush. Hero folded middle pair.
Hand 46: Villain SB called 9dJs. Board 8d Ks 6c. Villain bet 3 with OESD + backdoor diamonds. Hero folded.
Hand 48: Villain SB limped Qd6d. Board Jh Tc Ah. Villain bet 3 with OESD. Hero folded K-high.
Hand 50: Villain SB limped Qs5h. Board 8s Js Kh. Villain bet 3 with flush draw. Hero folded Ah4d.
Hand 52: Villain SB called 9s4c. Flopped nut straight. Bet flop, raised turn, bet river. Hero folded.
Hand 54: Villain SB limped 9cTh. Board Kd Kc 5h (DRY). Villain bet 3 with PURE AIR. Hero folded T-high.
Hand 56: Villain SB limped Tc8d. Board Jd 5d 6c. Villain bet 3 with gutshot + backdoor flush. Hero folded bottom pair.
Hand 58: Villain SB limped 3s4d. Board 9s 7s Ah. Villain bet 3 with flush draw. Hero folded Tc2s.
Hand 60: Villain SB limped 5s9d. Board 3s Qh Kh. Villain bet 3 with PURE AIR. Hero folded bottom pair.
Hand 64: Villain SB limped 9h7h. Board 6s 3h 2s. Villain bet 3 with PURE AIR. Hero folded PAIR+A-kicker (Ac6c) — major error.
Hand 66: Villain SB limped 7c8h. Board Th Qc Kc. Villain bet with PURE AIR. Hero folded 87o.
Hand 68: Villain SB limped 4d7h. Board Qs Kh Jd. Villain bet 3 with PURE AIR. Hero folded 3s8c.
Hand 76: Villain SB limped 5cJc. Board 6s 7d 8s. Villain bet 3 with GUTSHOT only. Hero folded QsJh (overcards).
Hand 78: Villain SB limped Kh8c. Board 7s 4s 6h. Villain bet 3 with K-high + gutshot. Hero folded Kc8s — clear fold error.
Hand 80: Villain SB limped 3d4d. Board 9d Tc 6c. Villain bet 3 with gutshot + backdoor flush draw. Hero folded middle pair (9h8d) — should have called!

Count: 18 times villain led/bet postflop.
- Made hands: 3/18 (H30 middle pair, H34 middle pair, H52 nut straight) = 17%
- Strong draws (6+ outs): 7/18 (H42, H44, H46, H48, H50, H56, H58) = 39%
- Weak draws / pure bluff: 8/18 (H54, H60, H64, H66, H68, H76, H78, H80) = 44%

IMPLICATION: Hero should call villain's flop bets with ANY pair or strong draw — villain only has made hand value 17% of the time. Villain is bluffing or semi-bluffing 83% of the time.
No sizing tell — small bets (~3 chips) used across all categories.
Villain bluffs ANY board texture (dry, semi-wet, low, high, Broadway, connected).
